As per your request, please find the 6-month rates for Laya Mansion studio apartment

September: AED 6,000
October: AED 7,500
November: AED 8,500
December: AED 9000
January :AED 8,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 3,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).

Thank you.
